falsifiable_hypothesis: The global-JS B-gain switch leaves orientation A at the response-free loo-bagged geometry. Because the same inner OOF contrast theta estimates the A/B residual difference, orientation A can receive a separately fitted correction along +theta. To prevent this secondary channel from overwhelming the already-strong A component, its gain is bounded to [-0.5,0.5], so the actual A prediction displacement 0.5*g_A*theta is at most one quarter of theta. Targetwise bounded-jackknife reliability shrinks uncertain A gains toward zero.
B_rule: Reproduce global_js_raw_gain_switch exactly for orientation B.
A_rule: For each outer partition use the same authenticated three inner whole-patient bandwidth-0.7 OOF tensors and the same held-fold theta_-k values. Let rA_k,j be the equal-patient A-orientation OOF residual mean. Fit gA_raw,j=2*sum_k n_k*theta_-k,j*rA_k,j / sum_k n_k*theta_-k,j^2, defaulting to 0 for a numerically zero denominator, then clip to [-0.5,0.5]. Recompute the same bounded A-gain estimator three times leaving out each held-fold pair and form standard K=3 jackknife variance vA_j. Define target reliability aA_j=gA_raw,j^2/(gA_raw,j^2+vA_j), zero when numerator and denominator are both zero. Define global A-signal reliability R_A=max(0,1-(24-2)*mean_j(vA_j)/sum_j(gA_raw,j^2)), zero for a numerically zero denominator. If R_A>0, use gA_j=aA_j*gA_raw,j; otherwise use gA_j=0. Apply qA=qA_loo_bagged+0.5*gA_j*theta_j.
bound_rationale: The A-side auxiliary gain magnitude is capped at one half, so its actual displacement is capped at one quarter of theta, while B retains the primary one-sided half-contrast correction. No bound menu is opened in canonical replay.

task_contract.ab_rule: average losses across separately costed A/B orientations; never average predictions
